label: record identifier
definition: Identifier of a record, building, meter, station or respondent within the dataset.

label: survey analysis weight
definition: Final sampling weight that expands a sampled record to the population it represents.

label: replicate weight
definition: Replicate weight used to estimate sampling variance (jackknife, balanced repeated replication).

label: imputation or quality flag
definition: Indicator that another variable's value was imputed, edited, top-coded or suppressed.

label: timestamp
definition: Date and time the observation refers to.

label: survey administration detail
definition: Information about how the record was collected (respondent type, interview mode, data source), not about the building.

label: geographic coordinates
definition: Latitude and longitude (WGS84) of a building, station or grid cell centroid.

label: administrative or statistical region
definition: Region the record belongs to, such as country, census region or division, state, county, city, tract or postal code.

label: climate zone
definition: Climate classification of the location (ASHRAE/IECC climate zone, building America zone, Koppen class).

label: urban or rural indicator
definition: Classification of the location by settlement type or density.

label: outdoor dry-bulb temperature
definition: Outdoor air temperature measured by a thermometer shielded from radiation and moisture.

label: outdoor dew-point temperature
definition: Temperature to which outdoor air must be cooled at constant pressure to reach saturation.

label: outdoor relative humidity
definition: Ratio of the partial pressure of water vapor in outdoor air to its saturation pressure.

label: atmospheric station pressure
definition: Atmospheric pressure at the station elevation.

label: global horizontal irradiance
definition: Total solar irradiance on a horizontal surface.

label: direct normal irradiance
definition: Beam solar irradiance on a surface normal to the sun.

label: diffuse horizontal irradiance
definition: Sky-diffuse solar irradiance on a horizontal surface.

label: wind speed
definition: Horizontal wind speed at the reference height.

label: wind direction
definition: Direction from which the wind blows, clockwise from north.

label: precipitation
definition: Liquid-equivalent precipitation depth over the time step.

label: heating or cooling degree days
definition: Sum over a period of the difference between a base temperature and daily mean outdoor temperature.

label: building footprint
definition: Polygon of the building's ground outline.

label: building height
definition: Height of the building from ground to roof (state reference points where known).

label: number of floors above ground
definition: Count of storeys above grade.

label: floors below ground or basement
definition: Count or presence of storeys below grade, including basements.

label: floor-to-ceiling height
definition: Typical vertical distance between floor and ceiling.

label: building plan shape
definition: Plan shape of the building (rectangle, L, U, H, courtyard, other).

label: roof shape or tilt
definition: Roof geometry type or slope (flat, pitched, gable, hip).

label: window-to-wall ratio
definition: Share of exterior wall area that is glazed.

label: building use type
definition: Principal activity or function of the building (office, retail, education, single-family, etc.).

label: secondary use or mixed use detail
definition: Additional activities in the building, or a finer subtype of its principal activity.

label: gross floor area
definition: Total floor area within the exterior walls, all storeys.

label: floor area category
definition: Binned floor area class.

label: year of construction
definition: Year (or period) the building was completed.

label: renovation or retrofit
definition: Whether and how the building was renovated (envelope, systems, lighting, additions).

label: exterior wall construction
definition: Material or assembly type of exterior walls.

label: roof construction
definition: Material or assembly type of the roof.

label: window and glazing properties
definition: Window type, number of panes, frame, coatings, tinting or shading.

label: insulation level
definition: Presence, level or upgrade of thermal insulation in walls, roof or floors.

label: space heating system
definition: Type, presence or share of space heating equipment (furnace, boiler, heat pump, district heat).

label: space cooling system
definition: Type, presence or share of space cooling equipment (chiller, packaged unit, central AC, room AC).

label: ventilation and air distribution
definition: Ventilation, economizer, variable-air-volume or air distribution features.

label: water heating system
definition: Type, fuel or size of domestic or service hot-water equipment.

label: lighting system
definition: Lamp types, lit share of floor area, or lighting controls.

label: plug and process equipment
definition: Presence or count of appliances, computers, refrigeration, cooking or other process equipment.

label: energy sources used
definition: Which fuels or energy carriers are used in the building, overall or for a given end use.

label: on-site generation or storage
definition: On-site renewable or fossil generation, cogeneration, or energy storage.

label: building controls and energy management
definition: Energy management systems, smart thermostats, demand response participation, or control strategies.

label: number of dwelling units
definition: Number of housing units in the building.

label: ownership, occupancy and tenure
definition: Who owns or occupies the building and how (owner-occupied, rented, government, vacant share).

label: rooms and space counts
definition: Counts or shares of specific spaces (bedrooms, classrooms, seats, beds, server rooms).

label: number of occupants
definition: Number of people who work in, live in or occupy the building.

label: operating hours and schedule
definition: Hours or days per week the building or a space is open or occupied.

label: thermostat setpoint
definition: Indoor temperature setpoint for heating or cooling, occupied or unoccupied.

label: equipment usage behavior
definition: How often or how long occupants use appliances or systems.

label: time-use activity
definition: Activity episodes of persons with time, duration and location.

label: thermal comfort response
definition: Occupant thermal sensation, preference or acceptability vote.

label: occupant control action
definition: Observed occupant interaction with building systems (window opening, light switching, blinds, thermostat change).

label: indoor environmental condition
definition: Measured indoor temperature, humidity, CO2, illuminance or air quality.

label: household or occupant demographics
definition: Socio-demographic attributes of occupants (age, income, education, employment).

label: total site energy consumption
definition: Total site energy over a period, all carriers combined.

label: electricity consumption
definition: Electricity used over a period.

label: natural gas consumption
definition: Natural gas used over a period.

label: other fuel consumption
definition: Fuel oil, propane, district heat or steam, wood or other carriers used over a period.

label: end-use energy consumption
definition: Energy attributed to one end use (heating, cooling, ventilation, water heating, lighting, cooking, refrigeration, office equipment, other).

label: energy expenditure
definition: Money spent on energy over a period.

label: energy use intensity
definition: Energy use per unit floor area over a year.

label: interval load or meter time series
definition: Energy or power at sub-annual intervals from a meter, sub-meter or aggregate.

label: peak demand
definition: Maximum power over a period.

label: primary energy or emissions
definition: Source energy, primary energy or greenhouse gas emissions attributed to energy use.

label: grid emission factor
definition: Emissions per unit of electricity generated or consumed in a grid region.

label: energy price or tariff
definition: Price per unit energy or demand, or tariff structure.

label: land use or land cover
definition: Land use class or land cover of the parcel or cell.
